info.title: Fincra API
info.description: Fincra API reference. Rebuilt from scratch against real service behavior, not migrated from the prior spec.

tags.name: Business
tags.description: Your business profile, the entity your Fincra integration acts on behalf of.

tags.name: Wallets and Balances
tags.description: Your business's currency wallets and their balances.

tags.name: Verification
tags.description: Confirm who you are paying, before you pay them.

get.description: Retrieves the active wallets for a business, including each wallet's ledger, available, locked, and rolling reserve balances. Pass `currency` to return a single matching wallet instead of the full list. Pass both `dateFrom` and `dateTo` to add opening and closing balances for that period to each wallet.

parameters.name: businessID
parameters.description: The `_id` returned by Get business profile.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Return only the wallet for this currency, instead of the full list.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Start of the period to compute opening/closing balances for. Requires `dateTo`.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: End of the period to compute opening/closing balances for. Requires `dateFrom`.

example.message: Wallets fetched successfully Stablecoin balances shown are Sandbox balances. Production access is not enabled by default and must be requested for Go live.

example.error: Cannot fetch wallets. Business not found

422.description: businessID is missing, or fails validation

value.error: Error occurred during payload validation. businessID length must be 24 characters long
errors: Error occurred during payload validation. businessID length must be 24 characters long

post.description: Creates wallets for a business. Pass `currencies` to create wallets for specific currencies, or omit it to create wallets for every currency the business has access to. Currencies that already have a wallet are skipped, so this is safe to call more than once. Returns every wallet the business now has, not only the ones just created.

businessID.description: The `_id` returned by Get business profile.

currencies.description: Currency codes to create wallets for. Omit to create wallets for every currency the business can access.

example.message: You have successfully created wallets for your business

example.error: Cannot create wallets. Business not found

422.description: One or more requested currencies are not supported for this business

example.error: Supplied currencies not supported. Supported currencies include [NGN,USD,GBP,EUR]

get.description: Retrieves a single wallet by its ID, including its ledger, available, locked, and rolling reserve balances. Pass both `dateFrom` and `dateTo` to add opening and closing balances for that period.

parameters.name: walletID
parameters.description: The `_id` (or numeric `id`) of the wallet, from Get wallets.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Start of the period to compute opening/closing balances for. Requires `dateTo`.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: End of the period to compute opening/closing balances for. Requires `dateFrom`.

get.description: Looks up a wallet by its `walletNumber`. Returns wallet and business identifiers only, no balances. Use Get wallet for balances.

post.description: Credits a wallet with a test amount. **Sandbox only**. This endpoint does not exist in Production. The wallet must already exist; create it first with Create wallets.

business.description: The `_id` returned by Get business profile.

data.description: The resulting credit record for this top-up.

404.description: No wallet exists for this business and currency

get.description: Lists transactions (debits and credits) across your wallets, newest first. Scoped to the authenticated merchant. Combine the filters below to narrow the results.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: The 24-character ID of the underlying transaction.

total.description: Matching row count, capped for performance on large histories. Exact when the true count is within the cap.

totalIsApproximate.description: Present and `true` only when `total` reflects the cap, not the true count.

get.description: Returns a statement for one wallet currency over a date range: opening and closing balances, the transactions in between, and pagination links. `currency`, `dateFrom`, and `dateTo` are required.

message.example: Wallet Log Statement from view fetched successfully

count.description: Number of results on this page.

next_page.description: Query string for the next page, or null on the last page.

422.description: currency has no wallet, or the date range is invalid

example.error: Wallet not found for currency: NGN

get.description: Retrieves a single wallet log entry by its numeric ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The log entry's numeric `id`, from Get wallet logs.

post.description: Exports wallet logs as a file. Defaults to the last 30 days if `dateFrom`/`dateTo` are omitted. Set `exportType` to `csv` for a CSV file; any other value returns a PDF.

exportType.description: `csv` for a CSV file; any other value returns a PDF.

dateFrom.description: Defaults to 30 days ago if omitted.

200.description: The exported file (CSV or PDF, per `exportType`).

get.description: Returns the top-level business you administer, including its verification status, notification preferences, Checkout settings and webhook configuration. Subaccounts are never returned by this endpoint. Use the `_id` in the response as your business ID wherever an endpoint requires `businessID` or the `x-business-id` header.

401.description: The request carried no valid API key.

example.message: No API key found in request

403.description: The API key is valid but the merchant has no business.

example.error: Merchant account does not have a business tied to it

500.description: Something went wrong on our end. Retry the request, and contact support if it keeps happening.

example.error: Error occured during operation. We're currently checking why this is happening.

get.description: Lists the top-level businesses associated with your API key. Subaccounts are excluded. If no businesses are found, `data` is returned as an empty array.

get.description:
Looks up the card scheme, brand, issuing bank and country behind a Bank Identification Number, the first six digits of a card number.

Use it to show a customer which card they are about to pay with, or to route a payment by scheme or card type before charging.

parameters.name: bin
parameters.description: The first six digits of the card number.

400.description: The BIN is not a number, or is shorter than six digits.

notANumber.summary: The BIN contains something other than digits

tooShort.summary: The BIN is shorter than six digits

401.description: The request carried no valid API key.

example.message: No API key found in request

apiKey.name: api-key
apiKey.description: Your Sandbox or Production API key, generated from your dashboard.

message.example: No API key found in request

error.description: A human-readable description of the error.

errorType.description: A stable category that identifies the type of error.

UpdateBusinessSettingsRequest.description: Settings to update. Include at least one property. Omitted properties retain their current values.

feeBearer.description: Determines who pays applicable transaction fees. `customer` adds the fee to the customer's charge; `business` deducts the fee from the business's proceeds.

settlementDestination.description: The default destination for supported settlements. A bank account must be configured before using `bank_account`.

enableWebhook.description: Whether Fincra sends webhook events to `callbackURL`.

enableWebhookRetry.description: Whether Fincra automatically retries failed webhook deliveries. This setting is disabled by default for new businesses.

callbackURL.description: The endpoint that receives webhook events. Supply a non-empty HTTP or HTTPS URL.

acceptMispayments.description: Whether supported Checkout flows accept overpayments and underpayments instead of initiating a reversal.

overrideBusinessEmail.description: An email address to use instead of the business's primary email where this override is supported. The value is stored in lowercase.

acceptedCurrencies.description: Requests wallet creation for the supplied currencies. This field is not stored in business settings; verify the resulting wallets separately.

success.description: Indicates that the settings update completed successfully.

message.example: You have successfully updated your business settings

WalletLog.description: A single debit or credit against a wallet.

message.description: "Wallets fetched successfully" in Sandbox, or Production. In Sandbox, if any returned wallet is a stablecoin/crypto currency, a notice about Sandbox-only balances is appended.

Wallet.description: Field set reflects the wallets service's `defaultSelects` projection (Postgres-backed), not the legacy Mongo wallet document.

_id.description: Wallet ID. Falls back to `id` if no Mongo-era ID exists.

openingBalances.description: Present only when `dateFrom` and `dateTo` are both supplied.

closingBalances.description: Present only when `dateFrom` and `dateTo` are both supplied.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the result.

BusinessProfile.description: A business on your Fincra account. Fields that have never been set are absent from the response rather than returned as null.

_id.description: The business ID. Pass this wherever an endpoint requires `businessID` or the `x-business-id` header.

name.description: The registered name of the business.

email.description: The primary email address for the business. Fincra sends notifications here unless `settings.overrideBusinessEmail` is set.

mobile.description: The business phone number, without the country calling code. Combine with `countryCallingCode` to form the full number.

countryCallingCode.description: The international dialling prefix for `mobile`, including the leading plus sign. `null` when it has not been set.

country.description: The two-letter code for the country the business operates in.

status.description: Whether the business can transact. A `disabled` business cannot collect payments or make payouts.

businessType.description: The industry the business operates in, as supplied during onboarding. Free text, not a fixed set of values.

businessKey.description: A stable identifier for the business, shown in your Fincra dashboard. Not accepted in place of `_id` by any endpoint.

businessTag.description: A sequential number assigned when the business is created, used for display and support reference. Not accepted as an identifier by any endpoint. Use `_id`.

logo.description: URL of the business logo. Absent when no logo has been uploaded. Displayed on Checkout when `checkoutSettings.useBrandLogo` is true.

website.description: The business website. Absent when it has not been set.

isKYCApproved.description: Whether the business has completed KYC. Some endpoints reject requests from a business that has not.

isBlocked.description: Whether Fincra has blocked the business. A blocked business is rejected on transacting endpoints regardless of `status`.

isPrincipalBVNWatchlisted.description: Whether the principal's BVN appears on a monitored watchlist. Set by Fincra's compliance screening.

settings.description: Operational settings. Change these with Update business settings.

feeBearer.description: Who pays transaction fees. `customer` adds the fee to the customer's charge; `business` deducts it from your proceeds. Defaults to `customer`.

settlementDestination.description: Where supported settlements are paid. `bank_account` requires a configured settlement account. Defaults to `wallet`.

enableWebhook.description: Whether Fincra sends webhook events to `callbackURL`. Disabled by default.

enableWebhookRetry.description: Whether Fincra retries webhook deliveries that fail. Disabled by default.

callbackURL.description: The endpoint that receives webhook events. `null` when no URL has been set.

acceptMispayments.description: Whether Checkout accepts overpayments and underpayments instead of reversing them. Enabled by default.

overrideBusinessEmail.description: An address that receives notifications instead of `email`. `null` when not set.

emailSettings.description: Which transaction emails Fincra sends. All are disabled by default.

disbursementNotification.description: Send an email when a payout is processed.

collectionNotification.description: Send an email when a payment is collected.

topupNotification.description: Send an email when a wallet is topped up.

settlementNotification.description: Send an email when a settlement is paid out.

paymentReceiptNotification.description: Send a receipt to the payer after a successful payment.

checkoutSettings.description: Appearance of the Fincra Checkout page. Colour fields accept CSS colour values and are `null` until set, in which case Checkout uses its defaults.

useBrandLogo.description: Show the business `logo` on Checkout instead of the Fincra logo.

buttonTextColor.description: Colour of the text on the Checkout button.

buttonColor.description: Background colour of the Checkout button.

fontColor.description: Colour of body text on Checkout.

backgroundColor.description: Background colour of the Checkout page.

backgroundTextColor.description: Colour of text placed on the page background.

settlementSettings.description: Settlement configuration for the business. `null` when none has been applied.

updatedAt.description: When the business was last modified.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the result.

Merchant.description: The account that owns your Fincra login and API credentials. Fields that have never been set are absent from the response rather than returned as null.

userId.description: The ID of the user account that signs in to the Fincra dashboard as this merchant.

name.description: The name given when the merchant account was created.

email.description: The merchant's email address. Unique across Fincra and used to sign in.

country.description: The two-letter code for the country the merchant signed up in.

logo.description: The merchant logo. Absent when no logo has been set. Stored as plain text with no format enforced.

mobile.description: The merchant's phone number. Absent when it has not been set.

incorporationNumber.description: The company registration number supplied during onboarding. Absent when it has not been set.

accessAllFeatures.description: Whether the merchant has been granted access to every Fincra product. False by default.

whitelistedIpAddresses.description: IP addresses allowed to call the API with this merchant's key. Absent when no allowlist has been configured.

howDidYouHearAboutUs.description: The answers given at signup to how the merchant found Fincra. Set once during onboarding.

monthlyTransactionVolume.description: The expected monthly transaction volume declared at signup. `null` when it was not supplied.

apiKeyRotatedAt.description: When the API key was last rotated. `null` if it has never been rotated.

apiKeyRotatedBy.description: Who last rotated the API key. `null` if it has never been rotated.

createdAt.description: When the merchant account was created.

updatedAt.description: When the merchant account was last modified.

business.description: The business attached to this merchant. Pass its `id` wherever an endpoint requires `businessID` or the `x-business-id` header.

businessKey.description: A stable identifier for the business, shown in your Fincra dashboard. Not accepted in place of `id` by any endpoint.

subBusinessIds.description: IDs of any subaccounts under this business. Empty when there are none.

ResolveNubanRequest.title: NGN bank account
ResolveNubanRequest.description: An NGN bank account, identified by its NUBAN and bank code.

type.description: Identifies the destination as an NGN bank account. This is the default, so a request that omits `type` is read as `nuban`.

currency.description: Defaults to `NGN`, so it can be left out.

accountNumber.description: The 10-digit NUBAN. Exactly 10 digits, no spaces.

bankCode.description: The bank's code, 3 to 6 digits, as returned by the banks list.

ResolveMobileMoneyRequest.title: Mobile money (GHS, KES)
ResolveMobileMoneyRequest.description: A GHS or KES mobile money wallet, identified by its network operator.

type.description: Identifies the destination as a mobile money wallet.

currency.description: Required. The operator alone does not imply the country.

accountNumber.description: The wallet's phone number in full international form, digits only.

mobileMoneyCode.description: The network operator, letters only, for example `MTN`, `AIRTEL` or `MPESA`.

ResolveBankAccountRequest.title: Bank account (GHS, KES)
ResolveBankAccountRequest.description: A GHS or KES bank account. The identifying field differs by currency: GHS is identified by `bankSwiftCode`, KES by `bankCode`.

type.description: Identifies the destination as a bank account.

currency.description: Decides which identifying field to send. GHS is identified by `bankSwiftCode`, KES by `bankCode`.

accountNumber.description: The account number, digits only. Neither currency fixes a length. It varies by bank.

bankSwiftCode.description: **GHS only, and required for GHS.** The bank's SWIFT/BIC code, 8 to 11 letters.

bankCode.description: **KES only, and required for KES.** The CBK national bank code, 1 to 4 digits, as returned by the banks list.

ResolveInteracRequest.title: Interac e-Transfer (CAD)
ResolveInteracRequest.description: A CAD Interac e-Transfer recipient, identified by their registered email. This checks whether the email is enrolled for auto-deposit.

type.description: Identifies the destination as an Interac e-Transfer recipient.

currency.description: Defaults to `CAD`, so it can be left out. `interac_etransfer` is CAD-only and no other currency is accepted.

interacEmail.description: The recipient's Interac email address. Only accepted for this type. Sending it with any other `type` is rejected.

ResolveIbanRequest.title: IBAN (EUR, GBP)
ResolveIbanRequest.description: An IBAN, for EUR and GBP. Resolves against a bank directory, so it returns the bank and branch rather than an account holder's name.

type.description: Identifies the destination as an IBAN.

iban.description: The full IBAN. No `currency` is sent. The country and bank encoded in the IBAN determine it.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the result.

data.description: The resolved destination. Which shape comes back follows the `type` that was sent.

ResolvedAccount.title: Named account
ResolvedAccount.description: A named account, returned for `nuban`, `mobile_money` and `bank_account`. The response never carries the bank or operator's display name, only the code used to reach it.

accountName.description: The name the account is held in.

accountNumber.description: The account number or wallet number that was resolved.

bankCode.description: The code the account was resolved against, echoed back. This carries whichever identifier was sent: the bank code for `nuban` and KES `bank_account`, the operator for `mobile_money`, and the SWIFT code for GHS `bank_account`.

ResolvedInteracAccount.title: Interac auto-deposit check
ResolvedInteracAccount.description: An Interac auto-deposit check, returned for `interac_etransfer`. There is no failure case: an email that is not enrolled is a real answer, so read the outcome from `autoDepositEnabled`.

email.description: The Interac email that was checked.

accountName.description: The name registered for auto-deposit, or `null` when the email is not enrolled.

autoDepositEnabled.description: Whether the email is enrolled for Interac auto-deposit. When `false`, `accountName` is `null`.

ResolvedIban.title: Bank directory record
ResolvedIban.description: A bank directory record, returned for `iban`. There is no `accountName`: an IBAN resolves to a bank and branch, not to an account holder.

accountNumber.description: The IBAN again, for consistency with the other response shapes.

bankCode.description: The bank's code within the directory.

branchName.description: The branch the IBAN belongs to.

country.description: The country the bank is in.

countryIso.description: The two-letter code for that country.

state.description: The branch's state, province or region.

bvn.description: The 11-digit Bank Verification Number to verify.

business.description: Your business ID, as returned by Get business profile. Required in the body even though your API key already identifies your business.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the result.

BvnIdentity.description: The identity record held against the BVN. Every field is personal data.

firstName.description: The holder's first name, as registered.

middleName.description: The holder's middle name. Absent when they have none registered.

lastName.description: The holder's last name, as registered.

dateOfBirth.description: The holder's date of birth, formatted `DD-Mon-YYYY`. Not an ISO date. Parse it accordingly.

phoneNo.description: The phone number registered against the BVN.

pixBase64.description: A base64-encoded photograph of the holder. Truncated in the example above; the real value is long.

status.description: Indicates that the request succeeded. This endpoint uses `status` where the rest of the API uses `success`.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the result.

BinDetails.description: What the card's first six digits identify.

bin.description: The six digits the lookup was performed against.

brand.description: The scheme's product name for this card.

country.description: The country the card was issued in.

code.description: The two-letter code for the country.

emoji.description: The country's flag, as an emoji.

type.description: Whether the card draws on a balance or a credit line.

lengths.description: The valid full card number lengths for this BIN. Use it to validate a card number before charging.

BadRequestError.description: The error shape used by this endpoint. It does not match the rest of the API, which returns `success`, `error` and `errorType`.

message.description: What was wrong with the request.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body.
